diagram.alt: A 2-by-3 grid with 1 of the 6 cells shaded

hint: Multiply the tops, multiply the bottoms.

hints.text: Multiply the tops, multiply the bottoms.

explanation: So the product is $\frac{1}{6}$ — half of a third of the grid.

alternativeExplanations.title: Grid picture
steps: Split a rectangle into 2 rows and 3 columns — 6 equal cells.
Half of one third is exactly 1 cell → $\frac{1}{6}$.
